title: FOV Changer
author: L4D2 PC Port
description: Sets your field of view with a slider, beyond the console's 90° limit. Also a template: copy this folder, rename it, and edit mod.json to make your own settings mod (see docs/MODDING.md).

settings.label: Field of view
settings.help: Field of view in degrees. The console version allows only 75-90; the port removes that limit. 90 is the default.
